versions.changelog: Public candidate v1.0.30: reviewed single-query Tavily search helper with bounded inputs, JSON output, and local tests.

Refresh public-candidate/no-publish-authority wording, declare TAVILY_API_KEY in OpenClaw metadata, add delayed response-body timeout regression coverage, and normalize final line endings. No runtime behavior change.
ClawHub publication/version refresh after public-readiness review; no runtime behavior change.
Clarify production Tavily calls use api.tavily.com while offline tests may use local 127.0.0.1 via TAVILY_TEST_ENDPOINT; no runtime behavior changes.
Harden flag parsing and failure handling; clarify Tavily API credits wording.
Add version metadata, polished env-key status wording, and sanitized representative success output for eval review.
Remove vestigial multi-key fallback path; keep single env-only TAVILY_API_KEY behavior.
Public polish: env-only credentials, ASCII-clean docs and examples, scanner-warning clarity, and package consistency checks.
Scanner cleanup: remove ~/.openclaw/.env file-reading fallback from public package; credentials are read from process environment only.
Initial public release: minimal zero-dependency Tavily search helper for OpenClaw skills.
